# Sentraa AI

> Sentraa AI (Sentraatech) is the pre-execution AI agent governance and security platform. It provides real-time tool-call interception, automated sensitive data redaction, shadow AI discovery, and continuous compliance mapping (GDPR, India DPDP, HIPAA, NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act) for enterprise autonomous AI systems.

## Overview
- **Product Name**: Sentraa AI
- **Organization**: Sentraa Technologies (Sentraatech)
- **Website**: https://sentraatech.com
- **Core Value Proposition**: Stop risky AI agent actions before they happen through fail-closed, sub-15ms pre-execution interception.
- **Category**: AI Agent Governance, Autonomous Agent Security, LLM Security, MCP (Model Context Protocol) Guardrails, AI Risk Management.

## Core Capabilities
- [AI Discovery](https://sentraatech.com/#capabilities): Automated discovery and cataloging of sanctioned and shadow AI agents across cloud connectors, APIs, Slack bots, and runtime traffic.
- [Pre-Execution Policy Enforcement](https://sentraatech.com/#capabilities): Inline bouncer evaluating tool calls, SQL mutations, and API requests against enterprise security policies in <15ms before execution.
- [Continuous Monitoring & Telemetry](https://sentraatech.com/#capabilities): 24/7 anomaly detection, agent drift tracking, and cryptographically signed (SHA-256) tamper-evident compliance audit logs.
- [Context vs Intent Architecture](https://sentraatech.com/#comparison): Semantic inspection of multi-agent reasoning chains and tool arguments, bridging the gap left by static DSPM, human IAM, and traditional EDR.

## Technical Specifications
- **Latency Overhead**: < 15ms evaluation pipeline.
- **Deployment Options**: Lightweight 2-line SDK, Inline Reverse Proxy, or Private Cloud Sidecar (AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes).
- **Security Defaults**: Fail-closed architecture, zero-trust pre-execution gating, in-memory dynamic PII masking.
- **Model & Framework Support**: OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Cloud / Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
- **Compliance Frameworks**: EU AI Act (Arts. 14, 15), NIST AI RMF 1.0, GDPR (Arts. 22, 35), India DPDP Act 2023, HIPAA Security Rule, PCI-DSS v4.0.
